items.title: Prato: Macarrão integral cozido + Tilápia grelhada + Abóbora cabotiá cozida
items.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: illustrative meal photograph for a nutrition recipe catalog. Primary request: a realistic appetizing serving containing ONLY these named catalog foods (names in Brazilian Portuguese): Macarrão integral cozido; Tilápia grelhada; Abóbora cabotiá cozida. Arrange the three foods in adjacent sections in a white ceramic shallow bowl. Atum fresco grelhado is fully cooked grilled tuna: opaque beige-tan flaky muscle chunks with browned edges, no pink or red center, no rare sliced steaks.
